children: NET Power advanced its Project Permian plan by acquiring EMPower’s owner position under a $196.7 million EPC for a 123-MW gas-fired facility, paying $58.95 million in cash to EMPower and assuming approximately $177.8 million of remaining commitments. At closing, NET Power also paid $58.63 million for engine-generator milestones, secured key consents from Saulsbury and Wärtsilä, obtained an extension of the full notice-to-proceed deadline to October 15, 2026, and received a first-priority security interest in the equipment. The project remains subject to a relocation and schedule change order, permits, financing, and other development milestones.
